messages:
Maria: We just received a chargeback from Cardholder's Bank for invoice INV-2026-0042 ($12,450). Reason: "fraudulent transaction - cardholder did not recognize". Bank wants evidence within 7 days. Can ops/eng pull the logs and transaction metadata?
Kira: On it. Can you paste the dispute id and any card/bin data we have? I’ll start assembling the evidence bundle and request PCI-safe redactions.
Maria: Dispute ID: DB-9817623. Payment processor sent BIN 4553xxxx and last4 1123. Billing addr matches customer profile but IP geo is different. Attaching support convo I have.
Sam: Pasting the support transcript we have (redacted):
```
Customer: I did not authorize this charge on 03/11.
Support: Can you confirm the last 4 of the card used?
Customer: 1123.
Support: We see account activity and API calls from this org on 03/10-03/11.
```
Sam: Customer was provisioned by partner-sales; they confirmed usage spikes.
Alejandro: Quick risk notes: 1) Billing vs IP geo mismatch -> medium risk 2) Multiple distinct API keys used within 24h window -> suspicious 3) No chargeback history on this account before.
Alejandro: Suggested evidence items we should send to the bank: merchant receipt, itemized usage (timestamps + API request IDs), signed TOS acceptance, IP + device logs, refund policy, and the support transcript. Also include the S3 CSV of events and a signed statement from finance.
Kira: I’ll generate `evidence_bundle.zip` with the following structure (PCI redacted):
```
/evidence_bundle/
  invoice_INV-2026-0042.pdf
  usage_events_INV-2026-0042.csv  # columns: timestamp, req_id, model, tokens
  api_key_activity.log
  support_transcript_redacted.txt
  tos_signed_customer.pdf
  finance_statement.pdf
```
Kira: Note: Payment provider requires PAN redaction and no full card numbers in attachments.
payment-webhook-bot: Payment provider webhook: {"dispute_id":"DB-9817623","amount":"12450","currency":"USD","received_at":"2026-03-12T09:14:22Z","reason_code":"customer_dispute"}
Devon: For the formal rebuttal we should follow this template to the processor:
```
- Dispute ID: DB-9817623
- Merchant reference: INV-2026-0042 / Customer: Acme Data Corp
- Chronology: detailed timeline of purchase, onboarding, API request evidence (attach CSV)
- Evidence: invoice, usage CSV, signed TOS, support logs, IP/device correlation
- Request: decline chargeback, suggest representment
```
Devon: Also recommend we put a temporary hold on the org until dispute resolved (no new billing) — legal OK?
Maria: Legal reviewed high-level, asked to preserve logs and not to admit liability in messages. Proceed with hold and representment. I authorize sending bundle to processor once Kira confirms redactions are applied.
Kira: Will upload evidence bundle to S3 (pre-signed link) and paste link here once done. Expected upload by EOD.
billing-bot: Uploaded evidence bundle to internal S3 at s3://redwood-evidence/DB-9817623/evidence_bundle.zip (ACL: private). Pre-signed link expires in 72h.
Kira: Pre-signed link: https://s3.redwood.example/DB-9817623/evidence_bundle.zip?sig=xxxx (redacted). Bank requires files in PDF/CSV only — no zip allowed. I’ll re-upload as individual files. 
Maria: Deadline reminder — bank cutoff is 2026-03-19 09:00 UTC (7 days). If we miss it they auto-win.
Alejandro: I’ll run fraud score analysis and share a short note to include in the packet (geo velocity + token reuse metrics).
Sam: FYI support will freeze outbound communications to the cardholder about refunds until we know outcome.
Devon: Once bundle is ready I’ll draft the representment narrative and route to Maria for signature.
Maria: Thanks team. Please add any receipts/ticket ids to the evidence index. :thumbsup:
payment-webhook-bot: Dispute status updated: DB-9817623 -> "awaiting_evidence" at 2026-03-12T12:02:03Z
Maria: Closing loop — upload + representment draft due by EOD 2026-03-12 PST. If anyone can't meet, call it out now.
Kira: On track.
Alejandro: On it.
Devon: Working on narrative now.
